title: Pin convergence after a synchronous follow-up saves delegation metadata but rejects the child session row
outcome: The follow-up owner explicitly documents and tests how durable delegation re-arm converges after its child session's row is rejected and memory is rolled back.
acceptance: A disposable follow-up regression with Some(previous) rejects the child's transcript row and inspects both durable delegation and child rows plus the existing memory rollback.
Document or repair convergence without falsely acknowledging the child row, losing follow-up custody or making an unrelated session or metadata commit fail.
